$comment: Gully Chain MAINNET (48559 on Arbitrum One 42161) for the bridge build with VITE_NETWORK=mainnet. Public values only. Every address left null is filled on launch day (gully-ops l3/mainnet RUNBOOK L-5/L-7) here in the launch PR or with the VITE_MAINNET_* build env (src/config/network.ts); until an address is set, the lane that needs it is never offered. Sources: gully-ops l3/mainnet/chain/rollup-config.json (ids, confirmPeriodBlocks 50400 = 7 days of 12 s L1 blocks), l3/mainnet/hyperlane/warp-eth-native.yaml (Arbitrum One mailbox), l3/mainnet/INFRA.md + docs/mainnet/DOMAIN-CUTOVER.md (hostnames), l3/mainnet/PLAN.md Phase 1 caps.

caps.$comment: Phase 1 guarded-launch caps (PLAN.md, owner decision D-CAPS). Raising one needs the owner's sign-off. fastDailyEth: PLAN.md names an on-chain 24 h rate limit but no number, so the UI has none (null).
